title: MiniCPM-V 4.7 35B-A3B Q4_K_M GGUF on llama.cpp, DGX Spark
slug_note: OpenBMB's vision MoE, served text-only by llama.cpp on the Spark: 75 tok/s.

variation.quant_detail: Q4_K_M, 21.17 GB; llama.cpp auto-pulls the repo's mmproj (mmproj-model-f16-4x.gguf, 0.91 GB loaded here)
variation.revision_note: HF snapshot resolved and served on the Spark during the 2026-10-27 test

engine.config: llama-server with -ngl 99 and --ctx-size 8192 (the -hf default picks up the repo mmproj automatically)

requirements.notes: Measured on a DGX Spark (2026-10-27): 22.1 GiB dropped from MemAvailable with the recipe as written (--ctx-size 8192).

steps.text: Install llama.cpp (see Step 0 in Quick start). On Ubuntu / DGX OS install libssl-dev first, or -hf cannot download.

measurements.method: openai_bench.py: streaming /v1/chat/completions, single stream, one warm-up discarded, fresh nonce per summarise prompt (cold prefill), decode = (completion_tokens-1)/(last-first token time), temperature 0.6, median of 3; summarise neutral filler (632-token prompt, 256-512 output tokens)

drop in MemAvailable from before start (OS file cache dropped) to server ready; llama-server build 11866 (commit 3f03b1772) with --ctx-size 8192

caveats: Works as written on a DGX Spark (2026-10-27): `llama-server -hf openbmb/MiniCPM-V-4.7-35B-A3B-gguf:Q4_K_M --ctx-size 8192 -ngl 99` — llama.cpp build 11866 (commit 3f03b1772); server ready 20 s after start with the OS file cache dropped; the functional check passed; MemAvailable dropped 22.1 GiB (weights + KV at --ctx-size 8192).
The existing MiniCPM-V 4.7 recipe is an untested lead with no literal command; this Spark recipe is the first runnable command for the model in this directory.
Vision was not exercised in the text bench; the functional check only answers a text question. llama.cpp loaded the repo mmproj automatically.
